compensating.new: return start > end ? "" : ToStringStyle.textWithin(str, start, end);
compensating.why: hop 1 gives the empty String when the start lies after the end
hop 3 never passes a start after the end
hop 4 never passes an end before the start

end = Math.max(0, Math.min(end, len));

ownership_reason: Only the gold resolves the two positions (a negative position counted back from the end, then moved inside the String) and so only the gold can compare them; the facade and hops 1-4 pass the raw positions, whose order is not the order of the resolved ones (the trigger's own (0, -8): raw start after end, resolved 0 before 3), so no one-line comparison or Math.min/Math.max of raw positions repairs it, and once the gold has thrown no caller can recover the result in one line. The convention is pinned outside the gold: the facade's javadoc ('If start is not strictly to the left of end, "" is returned', substring("abc", 2, 0) = ""); ArrayUtils.subarray, in the gold's own class, returns the empty array for an end before the start ('Undervalue (< startIndex) produces empty array') and ArrayUtilsTest.testSubarrayObject asserts 'start > end' -> ""; StringUtils.mid and StringUtils.right return "" for an empty or negative span (testMid_String: mid(FOOBAR, 9, 3) = "", testRight_String: right(FOOBAR, -1) = ""); substring(String, int) returns "" for a start past the end (testSubstring_StringInt).
